Carbon | Create and share beautiful images of your source code

name: Carbon
summary: Browser tool that turns source code into shareable images with syntax themes, window styles, backgrounds and PNG or SVG export.
description: A web tool for creating images out of source code, made for sharing code screenshots on social posts and docs. Import by pasting, dropping a file or appending a GitHub gist id to the URL, then style it with a syntax theme, background color or image, window theme and padding. Export as PNG or SVG, copy the image to the clipboard or tweet a link.
contains: create images of source code and share them
import by pasting, dropping a file or appending a GitHub gist id to the URL
customize syntax theme, background color or image, window theme and padding
export as PNG or SVG, copy to clipboard or tweet a link
keyboard shortcuts for settings, export, save snippet and reset
